svg.text: FOLLOW-UP AFTER 15S IDLE ON EVE MAIN: EVERY SPAN ON THE CRITICAL PATH, CLIENT P50 787MS
The POST from SF to Vercel's edge. Not traced: the two
network spans at either end total 201ms and are drawn
Routing to the server function in iad1.
The POST records the message in the run's event log.
The POST publishes a queue message to wake the
Vercel Queues invokes the flow function with the wake.
A fresh orchestrator loads the run's events
The workflow replays the log up to the new event.
The turn step's start is committed before its body
eve's turn step (~34ms to the model call), the mock
model, then the first stream write.
The client's open stream GET relays the first delta.
Box height is proportional to ms (minimum 46px). Medians of 19 follow-ups, Lambda iad1, client in SF, mock model; spans don't sum exactly to the p50.
